file_roles.evidence: Adds an empty override cleanShutdown(OperationContext*) {}, forced by the new pure virtual.
Adds an empty cleanShutdown override, forced by the new pure virtual.
Declares new pure virtual cleanShutdown and moves the virtual destructor; API plumbing for the real change.
'_engine.reset(NULL)' (deleting the engine on shutdown) is replaced by '_engine->cleanShutdown(txn); // intentionally not deleting _engine'.
Only a comment added above the _engine member.
Destructor used to close _conn while sessions could still be released; new cleanShutdown calls _sessionCache->shuttingDown() before _conn->close().

Adds _shuttingDown; releaseSession now takes _sessionLock first and returns ('leak session to avoid race condition'); getSession invariants on !_shuttingDown. This closes the race seen in the stack trace.
Declares shuttingDown() and adds the _shuttingDown field.

rationale: The segfault is in __wt_free_int reached from releaseSession -> dropAllQueued during shutdown, racing with engine teardown. The fix changes shutdown order and makes releaseSession lock-protected and shutdown-aware.
notes: Stack trace has no file names for the signal handler, so log location is not determinable.
